title: Geometry Dash Secret Key
blurb: Geometry Dash hides an absurd quantity of content behind vaults, passwords and collectibles. This is the chime that tells you a key has turned up somewhere you probably were not meant to be looking yet. Small, sparkling, and doing an enormous job, since RobTop's entire secrets economy runs on it. Players who have never cleared a demon level still recognise it from digging around the Vault of Secrets. Good for any moment of completely unearned discovery.
origin: The secret key collection sound from Geometry Dash.
